status: Retrospective source-model adequacy check, declared before calculating the symmetry statistic. The source model and some data have already been inspected; this is not a prospective preregistration.
primary_null: For each participant, task, stimulation condition, and nonzero absolute SOA, the probabilities of yes at +SOA and -SOA are equal. Pair probabilities are otherwise free.
reason_chosen: The released modelprediction_log_BCI.m uses centered Gaussian measurement noise and a centered symmetric interval, hence predicts p(s)=p(-s) for every parameter vector.
unit_structure: 30 participants x 2 tasks x 3 stimulation conditions x 3 positive SOA magnitudes = 540 pairs, two independent Binomial(10,p) counts per pair under the null. Zero-SOA cells are excluded from this test.
statistic: Sum over all pairs of twice the log-likelihood gain for separate positive/negative probabilities over their pair-pooled probability.
conditional_distribution: Condition on each pair's total yes count K. Its positive-SOA yes count has Hypergeometric(20,K,10) law. Simulate pairs independently conditional on their observed totals.
monte_carlo_rule: One planned run; upper-tail probability includes ties. Report plus-one p=(exceedances+1)/(B+1) and exact 95% binomial interval for the simulated conditional tail probability. Never report zero p.
subsidiary_outputs: Task and task-by-stimulation contributions and signed response differences are descriptive only. No subsidiary significance tests or post-hoc exclusions are planned.
data_checks: Verify all labels and counts, retain source mapping, and exactly cross-check reshaped tidy counts against empirical/alignment_diagnostic.npz. Record input SHA-256.
scope: A global test of centered symmetry under the conditional independent-binomial model; not a test of UCT, neural mediation, or the number of mechanisms. Rejection need not refute Bayesian causal inference generally. Dependence, trial-varying probabilities, or nonzero centers can violate the tested model.
no_refitting: No source parameters are fitted and no source widths are used. This conditional test is separate from relative BCI model comparison.
